Sarah (Product): Quick Q2 OKR milestone check — please call out what actually shipped vs slipped, owners, and any immediate CR/blocker asks. TL;DR: we need a short next-steps list by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tom (Eng): Shipping matrix: runtime-v2 canary ✅, model-catalog pagination shipped ✅, embeddings-eval slipped (perf regressions). Owner: me for runtime, @Lina for embeddings eval.
Lina (Eng-ML): embeddings-eval slipped — repro log shows 10-15% latency bump after quant change. Investigating perf & failing a couple of gold prompts. Will post a minimal repro by noon.
Raj (Platform): infra notes — dedicated pool autoscale had a missed policy tweak causing one pod to OOM during the run; I've queued a fix (infra#442). If teams need immediate extra capacity, I can open a reserve.
Tom (Eng): @Lina thanks. For the embeddings CR (repo: redwood/embeddings, PR #1278) can you tag reviewers? I need that merged before we roll quant back. Quick command: `gh pr checkout 1278 && make test-quick`
Lina (Eng-ML): tagging reviewers: @Tom, @Maya, @Raj. I'll add a short eval artifact and a perf diff table.
Maya (PM): For OKR accounting — we should mark embeddings-eval as 'partial' not 'failed' since some models still pass. I'll update the OKR tracker after owners confirm expected next milestone.
Tom (Eng): Can reviewers please prioritize CRs: runtime canary opts (PR #1302) and embeddings fix (#1278). Two-line asks in reviews is fine. :pray:
Raj (Platform): FYI deploy-bot scheduled a small canary tonight. deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 23:30 UTC to 10% of traffic for runtime-v2. Will auto-rollback on >1.5% error spike.
deploy-bot: Canary created: canary/rv2-2026-03-18-01, monitoring hooks enabled (latency, error-rate).
Lina (Eng-ML): If canary shows regression I'll push a patch to revert quant change — needs a +1 from infra to allocate warm GPUs.
Raj (Platform): I can allocate warm GPUs for the revert path, ping me directly and I’ll flip the reserve.
Maya (PM): Next steps (quick): 1) Owners confirm ship/slip state (Tom/Lina) — by 12:00 PT. 2) Reviewers prioritize two PRs (Tom/Lina) — asap. 3) Raj to confirm reserve ops if revert needed — done. 4) I'll update OKR tracker afterwards.
Tom (Eng): Confirmed: runtime-v2 canary = shipped-to-canary, embeddings-eval = slipped -> action plan posted by Lina.
Lina (Eng-ML): Confirmed. Will post repro + expected ETA (48h) and a short rollback PR if needed.
Maya (PM): Thanks — I'll mark milestone 'partial' and note the owners/actions. Anyone else with small asks?
Tom (Eng): Quick code-review ping to @Lina and @Raj: please prioritize the two PRs listed above. Add :eyes: to runtime PR if you can check perf traces.
Sarah (Product): Thanks everyone — this is perfect. I'll close the async check once Maya updates the tracker. :white_check_mark:
